headline: Sales and profit accelerate on strong comparable sales
summary_short: Costco's fiscal 2026 third-quarter net sales rose 12% to $69.15B and diluted EPS grew 15.2% y/y to $4.93, as comparable sales rose 10% and membership fees climbed 11% to $1.37B.
summary_long: Total revenue rose 11.6% y/y to $70.53B on net sales +12% (comparable sales +10%, 7% ex-fx/gas) and membership fees +11% to $1.37B. Gross margin fell 21bp to 11.04% (flat ex-gasoline) on core-category mix, offset by a smaller LIFO charge; SG&A leverage improved 20bp to 8.96% of sales. Operating income rose 11.3% to $2.82B and net income rose 15.2% to $2.19B, aided by higher interest income on larger cash balances and a lower 25.4% effective tax rate (vs 26.2%). Diluted EPS was $4.93 (+15.2% y/y). Cash and short-term investments ended the quarter at $19.99B (from $15.28B at fiscal year-end). Capex plan: ~$6.5B for fiscal 2026; quarterly dividend $1.47/share, up from $1.30 a year ago.

drivers.explanation: Net sales rose 12% on 10% comparable-sales growth (7% ex-FX/gas) plus 23 net new warehouses opened since Q3 2025; higher gasoline prices added 221bp and FX added 104bp to net sales.

Gross margin fell 21bp (flat ex-gasoline) on core-category mix, offset by a smaller LIFO charge and no repeat vacation-accrual charge; SG&A leverage improved 20bp as sales growth outpaced expense growth.
Operating income growth plus higher interest income from larger cash balances and a lower 25.4% effective tax rate (vs 26.2% a year ago) lifted net income growth above operating income growth.
Net income growth of about 15% combined with a slightly lower diluted share count from ongoing buybacks lifted diluted EPS by the same roughly 15% y/y.

Management reaffirmed intent to spend approximately $6.5B on capex in fiscal 2026 and open 13 more warehouses this year; a $1.47/share quarterly dividend was declared and paid, up from $1.30 a year earlier.
